# EarthquakeNPP benchmark datasets

`earthquakenpp` · adapter 1.0.0 · makes `seismic_catalog` tokens

| | |
|---|---|

## Terms

The repository is MIT-licensed; the ComCat dataset is USGS ANSS ComCat, U.S. public domain. Cite the benchmark and the catalogue.

## Cite

- Stockman, S., Lawson, D. J., Werner, M. J. (2026). EarthquakeNPP: A Benchmark for Earthquake Forecasting with Neural Point Processes. Transactions on Machine Learning Research. https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.08226
- U.S. Geological Survey (2017). ANSS Comprehensive Catalog (ComCat). https://doi.org/10.5066/F7MS3QZH

## Access

One CSV per dataset from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ss15859/EarthquakeNPP/26d18048e1ca8ff2b02c7016b993de48ed0760f5/Datasets/` (commit `26d18048e1ca`), downloaded once and cached by hash.

## From the source to the token

| Token slot | Comes from |
|---|---|
| `kind` | `event` |
| `lat, lon` | latitude, longitude |
| `depth_km` | not in the dataset: 0 with a vertical 1σ of 15 km |
| `time` | time (UTC) |
| `value` | magnitude |
| `qualifiers` | magnitude_type `M` (the dataset gives none), event_id ← id |

## Uncertainty

Magnitude 1σ an assumed 0.2; depth unknown (vertical 1σ 15 km); `uncertainty_basis: assumed`.

## Known issues

- The datasets are already cut by their authors (ComCat_25: California's polygon, M ≥ 2.5, 1971 to 2020-01-17). That is the point: CB-29 reads what they read.
- No depth and no magnitude type survive in the CSV.
